lines.text: "reason": "FAIL for final acceptance: 30 accounting snapshots and the review-bundle identity are reproducible, but no complete eligible formal snapshotRunId/contentHash/manifestDigest binds market plus fundamentals under the unchanged acceptance contract. Default DB has no formal snapshot/acceptance

currentRule: Data Snapshot ID reproducible. §22 every scoring/recommendation binds deterministic universe, market/fundamental cutoffs, source/import versions, quality/freshness and exceptions. Current SnapshotRequest requires MARKET and bindDIAcceptance requires exact FORMAL AS_KNOWN snapshot.
problem: One formal snapshot contract is used both as initialization acceptance evidence and analysis/decision data binding. Fundamental hashes or a review-bundle hash do not satisfy the current composite formal snapshot contract.
proposedRule: DI12-vNext verifies an immutable InitializationManifest binding certified universe/master/sector versions, qualified canonical accounting and history, provenance, Level1 dispositions, PolicyB29/1 and ACTIVE TCX exception, policies/software/import versions and capability certificate hashes. AnalysisSnapshot separately freezes the as-of compatible fundamental, market, universe/sector and model inputs; DecisionSnapshot atomically freezes the analysis and current portfolio context.
whySafer: A durable initialization identifier can replay after market values age, while every investment output remains pinned to a complete fresh-as-consumed analysis and decision envelope.
whenItFails: Initialization content/provenance/qualification/exception is missing or hash does not replay
Only a documentation bundle identity is offered instead of typed initialization manifest
Analysis or decision binding omits required market/portfolio/policy/model references
Hash-only identifiers exist without retained bytes or approved replay dependencies

INITIALIZATION_TIME: InitializationManifest replay under new approved contract
ANALYSIS_TIME: Complete AnalysisSnapshot replay, including required market source bytes
DECISION_TIME: Atomic DecisionSnapshot binding and portfolio watermark

compatibility: Do not edit v1 SnapshotRequest to allow empty MARKET or null marketCutoff, nor weaken existing FORMAL_AS_KNOWN validation. Add a distinct initialization contract and prospective analysis/decision bindings; legacy accepted snapshots replay unchanged.
